Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Watsonville for 2026, and here is what he found: 3 family events, 2 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (the opening night of Sparky's Holiday Lights) through December 24, with Noche de Brillo and the Lighted Parade (December 6) and Homemade Holiday: Make the Night Bright at the library (December 14) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Watsonville

  • Parades and tree lightings: the Lighted Parade and holiday tree lighting at Noche de Brillo (December 6)
  • Lights: Sparky's Holiday Lights at the Santa Cruz County Fairgrounds (November 27 to December 24)

  • Season: November 27 to December 24
